Paid gross."}],"notes":"Schedule for D-001 (Atlas Growth Fund I LP; record date 2026-10-30, payment date 2026-11-16), prepared through step 9 and unsigned. Rates are in percent (30 = 30%).

RECONCILIATION (C3.4)
- Gross: 12,000,000.00, matching notice DOC-0201 (D-001-A dividend 10,000,000; D-001-B return of capital 2,000,000).
- Tax: 1,510,562.50, all on D-001-A.
- Net: 10,489,437.50.
- Treasury lines agree with register holdings at the record date, which sum to 100%.

DECISIONS FOR YOU
1. I-006 Meridian Holdings I: I put the 300,000 dividend at the 30% default (tax 90,000) rather than the 15% treaty rate (tax 45,000). This is the one judgement call on the schedule.
   - CL-006 still reads "cleared" to 2027-12-31, but it relies on ownership fact DO-003, which ended 2026-07-31. Change case K-006 has been open since 2026-08-20 with no outcome.
   - The form's treaty claim rests on an ownership-based limitation-on-benefits test, so I did not treat the reduced rate as supported on the payment date.
   - The new declaration (DOC-0106) shows a circular holding: Meridian I is 30% held by Meridian II, which is 30% held by Meridian I. The other 70% of each is held by Meridian Family Trust (Jersey), so by my calculation the trust still ultimately owns 100%, as before.
   - Neither Meridian II (I-018) nor the trust (I-019) has a tax form, residence record or tax status on file.
   - If K-006 confirms the clearance before payment, the line returns to step 9 at 15% under R-02. If you think CL-006 stands as it is, the same change applies: tax falls by 45,000.
2. I-015 Bertrange Capital: 30% default (tax 150,000). Form F-015 ended 2025-12-31 and the clearance was withdrawn in K-015 after no reply. A new valid W-8BEN-E before the payment date would cure it; with a Luxembourg treaty claim the rate would be 15% (5% holding, 4% effective vote).
3. I-014 Client account 7731: 30% default on its 37.5% share of the Sterling Nominees payment (tax 67,500). No certification has ever been supplied (MF-001). The cure is a tax form for the beneficial owner, through Sterling.
4. Default instead of hold: the LPA (DOC-0001) is not digitised, so I could not confirm the fund's terms allow a hold. All three uncleared lines are therefore on the default rate.

REDUCED RATES TO REVIEW (C3.3)
The 5% rate (R-03) needs at least 10% effective vote in Orion. I computed this as the investor's fund vote x 100% (fund in SPV) x 80% (SPV in Orion).
- I-003 Kirchberg: 12.5% x 80% = 10.0%, exactly at the threshold, so 5% applied. At 15% the tax would be 187,500 instead of 62,500. Any change in holding before the record date would tip it.
- I-004 Limpertsberg: 12.4875% x 80% = 9.99%, just under, so 15%.
- I-005 Grund: 13% economic but 10% vote (class B limited voting), so 8.0% effective and 15%. On economic share it would be 10.4%.
- I-010 Ardennes (through the feeder): 50% x 24% x 80% = 9.6%, so 15%.
- All other Luxembourg treaty claimants are well under 10% and sit at 15% (R-02).
- The rulebook cites only "Article 10" of the 1996 US-Luxembourg Convention, with no paragraph. It has no separate pension rule, so the two pension funds (I-001, I-013) are at 15%.

LOOK-THROUGH LINES
- Atlas Lux Feeder SCSp (I-002) and Sterling Nominees (I-007) are flow-through or intermediary recipients, so their amounts are shown against the underlying owners.
- The feeder's 2,880,000 (payee CP-102) is split I-010 50%, I-011 30%, I-012 20%. Tax 432,000; net to the feeder 2,448,000.
- Sterling's 720,000 (payee CP-107) is split I-013 62.5%, I-014 37.5%. Tax 123,750; net to Sterling 596,250.

DATA POINTS
- Two investors are both named "Alpha Holdings SA". I-008 is the Luxembourg one (B 214 577, payee CP-108, 15%); I-009 is the Swiss one (CHE-318.442.907, payee CP-109, 30%, no treaty claim). I matched them by registration number; the payment file should do the same.
- Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle (I-016) is 3% in the investor register and the treasury lines, but 3.5% in entity management (H-006). I used 3%; at 3.5% the holdings would total 100.5%. No tax effect, since it is on a W-9.
- The record date is still ahead. Holdings are those currently registered as effective on 2026-10-30; any transfer before then means re-running step 9.
- I-008 (8% to 6%) and I-015 (3% to 5%) changed holdings on 2026-07-01. The schedule uses the current figures.

NOT DONE
- My access is read-only, so no distribution case, component marking or schedule row has been written to the clearance tables. The schedule exists only in this return.
- Notices under C3.7 are still to be sent by investor relations to I-015, to Sterling Nominees for I-014, and to I-006, each with the item needed to cure.
- Second review, sign-off and release (steps 10 to 12) are not performed."}
